DRIVE_SYNC.description: Writes specs as Google Docs, then refreshes the source. Reliable, recommended.

notebook.cookieHint: Leave empty to use the shared NotebookLM connection in Settings › Integrations. Fill it in only if this project uses a different Google account.

autoSyncOnApprove.label: Sync to NotebookLM automatically after approving a change

confirmBeforeSync.label: Ask for confirmation before syncing
confirmBeforeSync.hint: Asks before every upload to NotebookLM.

google.title: Google Drive
google.description: Sign in once. Used by Workspaces stored on Drive and by NotebookLM sync through Drive.
google.connected: Drive access was granted through OAuth and is shared by every project.
google.notConfigured: Google sign-in isn't set up on the server. Please contact your administrator.

notebooklm.title: NotebookLM
notebooklm.description: Connect with your Google sign-in. Spec Studio works with NotebookLM directly to add, sync and replace sources, with no CLI to install.
notebooklm.step1: Open notebooklm.google.com (signed in), press F12 and choose the Network tab.
notebooklm.step2: Reload the page, pick any request to notebooklm.google.com, then open Headers and Request Headers.
notebooklm.step3: Copy the whole Cookie value and paste it here.
notebooklm.warning: The cookie is your Google sign-in. It is stored (encrypted) on this machine only and sent nowhere except notebooklm.google.com. It expires after a few weeks; paste it again then.
notebooklm.loginChromeHint: Opens Chrome with Spec Studio's own profile. Close the window after you sign in. Next time you usually won't need to sign in again.
notebooklm.waitingLogin: Sign in to Google in the Chrome window that just opened, then close it so Spec Studio can pick up the sign-in.

exportImport.title: Export / Import settings
exportImport.description: Export your basic settings (Direct API, CLI Agent, connections) to use on another machine. The file has no API keys, tokens or accounts, so on the new machine you need to sign in or enter them again.
exportImport.invalidFile: This isn't a Spec Studio settings file.
exportImport.importConfirmDescription: Direct API and CLI Agent settings will be fully replaced. Connections with the same name are skipped, and existing connections are never removed.
exportImport.importSkipped: Skipped {count} connection(s) with the same name: {names}.
exportImport.importSummary: {count, plural, one {# connection} other {# connections}} · exported {date}
